aws.review.configuration.selected_conten.summary: Remove exposed credential literals and rotate confirmed exposed credentials.
steps: Replace exposed literal credentials with scoped workload identity or a secret reference.
Rotate confirmed exposed credentials and re-scan the selected configuration.
caveats: Only explicitly selected returned literals are assessed; referenced content and credential validity are not tested.

aws.review.s3.selected_source_secret_ind.summary: Remove the exposed literal and rotate the affected credential.
steps: Move credentials out of the selected object and use a supported secret reference or workload identity.
Rotate the exposed credential and re-scan the object.
caveats: Only selected supported text is assessed; referenced content and credential validity are not checked.

aws.review.codebuild.selected_inline_bui.summary: Remove the exposed credential from the inline buildspec and rotate it. Use a supported secret reference.
steps: Remove credential literals from the inline buildspec and use supported secret references.
Rotate exposed credentials and review their use.
caveats: Only returned inline build instructions are inspected; referenced files and build artifacts are outside this check.

aws.review.workload.selected_command_lit.summary: Remove secret literals from the selected task or job definition.
steps: Remove secret literals from the selected task or job definition.
Rotate exposed credentials and update affected workloads to a corrected revision.
caveats: Image defaults, external files and runtime overrides are not inspected.
